entities.summary: Ejike Ebenezer Obumneme Aghanya was a military officer and electrical engineer who served in the Nigerian Army and the Biafran Armed Forces, retiring as a colonel. Accused of involvement in the 1966 Nigerian coup d'état he was arrested and imprisoned without trial until the outbreak of the Nigerian Civil War where he served on the side of Biafra, holding key positions in the Biafran Armed Forces. He was the head of the Biafran Agency for Research and Production (RAP) which produced bombs, rockets, missiles, as well as ammunition, armored vehicles, telecommunication gadgets and petroleum refineries among others for the Biafran Armed Forces.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a key figure in the Biafran Armed Forces and head of the Biafran Agency for Research and Production (RAP), Ejike Obumneme Aghanya played a crucial role in producing military equipment for the Biafran forces during the Nigerian Civil War, contributing to the conflict's duration and outcome.
